modules: kv/store txn GC lock resolving (via client-go)
subject: txn: Update client-go to fix the issue that GC BatchResolveLcok may miss primary pessimistic locks (#45143)
summary: This commit is a dependency-only behavior change: it bumps `github.com/tikv/client-go/v2` to `v2.0.8-0.20230704071705-c0cf773917d9` (and aligns Bazel `DEPS.bzl`) and extends `tests/realtikvtest/pessimistictest/pessimistic_test.go` with `TestIssueBatchResolveLocks` to verify GC `gcworker.RunResolveLocks` clears a leaked primary pessimistic lock (issues #43243/#45134). Reviewing the upstream client-go delta for the bumped range shows the intended fix: `LockResolver.BatchResolveLocks` now calls `getTxnStatus` before resolving pessimistic locks, preventing the prior case where a primary pessimistic lock (key == primary) could be skipped by `resolvePessimisticLock`’s early-return assumption. No Blocker/High issues in correctness/data consistency/txn semantics were identified from the TiDB-side changes or the targeted upstream fix included by this version bump.
